item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera blows exhaled air through a straw into lime water in a test tube, while her brother Arjun passes inhaled (outside) air into a second tube of lime water using a syringe. The lime water in Meera's tube turns milky much faster. What is the correct conclusion from this experiment?

options.A: Exhaled air contains more carbon dioxide than inhaled air, but it still contains some oxygen.
options.B: Exhaled air contains no oxygen at all, only carbon dioxide.
options.C: Inhaled air contains more carbon dioxide than exhaled air.
options.D: Lime water turning milky shows that oxygen is present in the air.
